Name: Emily Revised - Seasonal
Author: stanloona420
Description:
This mod won't work in your game by itself, it requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]. If you don't use Seasonal Outfits you can download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9922]this version[/url] instead!
All designs used in this upload are my own except for the Flower Dance designs by Poltergeister, and the aerobics outfit from Seasonal Outfits!


[u][size=4]To Use With Seasonal Outfits
[/size][/u]
Download and unzip the file.
Open the new unzipped file and copy the folder named [b]assets[/b]. The files will replace the Emily files from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url] mod so make a backup of them if you want, but you can always redownload it to restore the original files.
Open Seasonal Outfits and paste the folder you copied from my folder. A prompt should come up asking if you want to replace existing files. Say yes and then you should be all set!


* My seasonal mods are currently not compatible with Diverse Stardew Valley, unless you want to modify your own game files in a way that will make them work together. I will be working on this, but at the moment I cannot help with the issue if you want to use both mods.
